name: Neil McLachlan
headline: Consulting Practice Director at Infor
about:
A very capable and experienced Professional Services Manager with a strong background spanning Consultancy, Implementation, Architecture and Development.

A profit-responsible manager with a proven record in planning and execution of organisational objectives, motivating and empowering combined onshore and offshore teams to achieve customer success. 

Focused on customer and stakeholder enablement, promoting ease of use and adoption of new technologies and processes to improve their overall experience and promote growth.

Conscientious, hard-working and infectiously positive, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills and a proven ability to operate effectively at all levels and across multiple disciplines.
… more

experiences.description:
Complete managerial responsibility for a diverse, international team of Professional Services Consultants, with a variety of skills and across multiple disciplines and product lines. 

The role includes flexible scheduling, revenue forecasting and targeting, technical development and training, developing Best Practice processes and working at all levels with customer and internal stakeholders. 

As a key escalation point for customer and product issues, the role includes a strong element of customer and support liaison, and incorporates management of sensitive customer data.

Selected Achievements

- Managed the incorporation of offshore resources into a cohesive combined team
- Advocated and realised new technology streams as consulting services
- Successfully mentored new and existing team members to a position of full utilisation
- Collaborated internationally on the successful production of common processes and standards
- Reduced costs, improved quality of service delivery and follow-up using Six Sigma techniques

The provision of high-value Technical Consulting services to customers, pre-sales prospects and internal departments, including:

- System Architecture Design

- Multi-site and Cross-Platform installation and configuration of multiple software products and components

- Complex Integration and Application Development

- Effective delivery of end user and Technical Specialist training

Selected Achievements

- Successful development of complex time-critical integration systems for automotive clients

- Design and development of integrated web-based product configuration system, in live use by major retailers

- Many successful pre-sales presentations and resultant system architecture designs for large organisations, with hardware budgets in excess of 200k
